FX-TXO-001.says: Plain words: one group per letter, no group for the space; T, x and t have one contour each, e two (its eye a hole).

FX-TXO-002.says: Holes: O and 8 and B, each outer contour Add and each inside Subtract.

FX-TXO-003.says: Centred, two lines: the second line a line lower, each centred on the place.

FX-TXO-004.says: A Text Animator as it is on the frame: Rotation 30, Position 10, -20 and a red fill on every letter; the outlines are where the letters are drawn.

FX-TXO-020.says: A text layer named Title, moved and turned 10 degrees, frames 2 to 20: both commands add a layer named "Title Outlines" just above it with its transform and times, and switch Title off.
FX-TXO-020.name: Title Outlines

FX-TXO-021.says: Words that are only spaces have no outline: both commands are refused, saying so, and nothing is added.
